recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken & Potatoes
recipes.summary: Crispy-skinned thighs roasted on a bed of garlicky potatoes and carrots. One pan, almost no washing up.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes, carrots and onion with 2 tbsp oil and half the salt on a large sheet pan.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, garlic powder, paprika, thyme, salt and pepper. Nestle it skin-side up on the vegetables.
Roast 40–45 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the chicken reads 175°F (80°C).
Rest 5 minutes, then spoon the pan juices over everything.

recipes.title: Weeknight Beef & Bean Chili
recipes.summary: A big, cozy pot that stretches one pound of beef with two cans of beans. Better the next day.
steps: Brown the beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Spoon off excess fat.
Add the onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Taste for salt and serve with cheese, sour cream or green onions if you have them.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.summary: The tangy, saucy classic — ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat. Drain the fat.
Add the onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard and salt. Simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Toast the buns and pile the filling on.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potatoes
recipes.summary: Fluffy potatoes with broccoli, cheese and a dollop of sour cream.
ingredients: 1 crown broccoli, cut into small florets
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt, and bake directly on the rack for 50–60 minutes.
In the last 10 minutes, steam or microwave the broccoli until just tender.
Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and season with pepper.
Top with broccoli, cheese, sour cream and green onions. Return to the oven 3 minutes to melt the cheese.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: The real thing, from scratch, for the price of a takeout coffee.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot. Cook the onion, carrots and celery 6 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, thyme, bay leaves and whole chicken thighs. Simmer 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot.
Add the noodles and simmer 7–8 minutes until tender. Season with salt, remove the bay leaves and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Broccoli Mac & Cheese
recipes.summary: Creamy stovetop mac with broccoli cooked right in the pot.
ingredients: 1 crown broccoli, cut into small florets
steps: Cook the macaroni in salted water. Add the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
In the same pot, melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk and simmer 4 minutes until it thickens.
Off the heat, stir in the cheese, garlic powder, mustard and salt until smooth.
Fold in the pasta and broccoli. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Sausage & Peppers
recipes.summary: Smoky sausage, sweet peppers and potatoes — 10 minutes of work.
ingredients: 1 lb potatoes, cut into small chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything on a sheet pan in a single layer.
Roast 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, until the potatoes are golden and the sausage is browned.

recipes.title: Mini Meatloaves
recipes.summary: Little loaves cook in half the time and come out glazed and juicy.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, onion, garlic powder, salt and pepper with your hands until just combined.
Shape into 4 small loaves on a lined sheet pan.
Stir the ketchup, brown sugar and mustard; brush over the loaves.
Bake 25 minutes, until cooked through. Great with mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Drumsticks
recipes.summary: Sticky, sweet-savory drumsticks — the cheapest cut, the biggest smiles.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic, oil and pepper. Toss the drumsticks in half of it.
Roast on a lined pan for 35 minutes, turning once.
Brush with the remaining sauce and roast 8–10 minutes more until sticky.
Scatter with green onion. Serve with rice and a vegetable.

recipes.title: Tuna Melts
recipes.summary: Crispy, cheesy, ready in 15 minutes from the pantry.
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery, mustard and lemon juice.
Spread on 4 slices of bread, top with cheese and the remaining bread.
Butter the outsides and cook in a skillet over medium heat, 3 minutes per side, until golden and melted.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken & Rice Bake
recipes.summary: Everything bakes together in one dish — rice, chicken, broccoli and cheese.
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a 9×13 dish, combine the rice, chicken, onion, garlic powder, paprika and salt. Pour over the hot broth and stir.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 40 minutes.
Stir in the broccoli, top with the cheese and bake uncovered 10–15 minutes until the rice is tender.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.summary: Savory beef and vegetables under a fluffy mashed potato lid.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water 15 minutes until tender. Drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brown the beef with the onion and carrots, 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire, thyme and salt, then the broth. Simmer 8 minutes until thick. Add the peas.
Spread the filling in a baking dish and top with the mash. Rough up the top with a fork.
Bake 20 minutes, until the top is golden.

recipes.title: Split Pea & Ham Soup
recipes.summary: Thick, smoky and filling — a classic penny-pincher.
steps: Rinse the split peas.
Put everything in a large pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce to a simmer, partly covered, for 60 minutes, stirring now and then, until the peas break down.
Remove the bay leaves and season to taste. Thin with water if needed.

recipes.title: Juicy Turkey Burgers
recipes.summary: Grated onion keeps them tender. Lighter than beef, just as satisfying.
steps: Mix the turkey, onion, garlic, Worcestershire, salt and pepper gently. Shape into 4 patties.
Cook in the oil over medium-high heat, 5–6 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside.
Serve on toasted buns with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.title: Crispy Black Bean Burgers
recipes.summary: Pantry burgers with a crisp crust and smoky spice.
steps: Pat the beans dry and mash them in a bowl, leaving some chunky.
Mix in the breadcrumbs, egg, onion, cumin, paprika and salt. Shape into 4 patties and chill 10 minutes if you have time.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, 4–5 minutes per side, until crisp.
Serve on buns with salsa.

recipes.title: Creamy Potato Soup
recipes.summary: Velvety, cheesy and made mostly of potatoes — the cheapest comfort there is.
steps: Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion and celery 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and broth. Simmer 15 minutes until very tender.
Mash about half the potatoes in the pot for a creamy-chunky soup.
Stir in the milk and cheese until melted. Season and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork
recipes.summary: Cheap shoulder becomes tender, saucy sandwiches for a crowd.
steps: Rub the pork with the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Put the onion in the slow cooker, add the pork, water and vinegar.
Cook on LOW 8 hours (or HIGH 5) until it falls apart.
Shred with two forks, discard the fat and stir in the BBQ sauce.
Pile onto buns. Leftovers freeze beautifully.

recipes.title: Biscuit-Topped Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.summary: All the comfort of pot pie with a shortcut biscuit lid.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In an oven-safe skillet, cook the chicken in 1 tbsp butter until browned. Set aside.
Melt the remaining butter, cook the onion and carrots 5 minutes, stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in the broth and milk; simmer until thick. Add the chicken, peas, thyme and salt.
Top with the biscuits and bake 15 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Crispy Black Bean Tacos
recipes.summary: Smoky beans, crunchy cabbage and lime — a $1-a-serving favourite.
steps: Warm the beans in the oil with the cumin, chili powder and salt, mashing about half.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet until soft and lightly charred.
Fill with beans, cabbage, salsa and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Burrito Bowls
recipes.summary: Better than the chain — and a quarter of the price.
steps: Cook the rice. Stir in the zest and juice of the lime and the cilantro.
Toss the chicken with the taco seasoning and oil. Sear in a skillet 6 minutes per side, rest, then slice.
Warm the beans and corn together.
Build bowls: rice, beans and corn, chicken, salsa, sour cream and cheese.

recipes.title: Beef & Bean Enchiladas
recipes.summary: Saucy, cheesy and stretched with beans so it feeds everyone.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brown the beef and onion, drain, then stir in the beans, spices and ½ cup enchilada sauce.
Spread ½ cup sauce in a baking dish. Fill each tortilla with beef and a little cheese, roll and place seam-side down.
Pour over the remaining sauce, top with cheese and bake 20 minutes until bubbly. Scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
recipes.summary: Ten minutes, five ingredients, zero complaints.
steps: Stir the cumin into the beans.
Spread beans over half of each tortilla, add cheese and fold.
Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat, 2–3 minutes per side, until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.summary: Bright, brothy and a little smoky, with crunchy toppings.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, garlic and jalapeño 5 minutes. Stir in the spices.
Add the tomatoes, broth and whole chicken breasts. Simmer 20 minutes, then shred the chicken.
Add the beans and corn and simmer 5 minutes. Finish with lime juice.
Meanwhile, cut the tortillas into strips and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 8 minutes until crisp.
Serve topped with tortilla strips and cilantro.

recipes.title: One-Pan Turkey Taco Rice
recipes.summary: Taco night in a single pan, with the rice cooked right in.
steps: Brown the turkey and onion in a deep skillet.
Stir in the taco seasoning and rice for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth. Cover and simmer 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Top with the cheese, cover 2 minutes to melt, then scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
recipes.summary: Sizzling peppers and chicken, no standing over the stove.
ingredients: 1.5 lb chicken breast, sliced into strips
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil and seasoning on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 minutes, then switch to broil for 3 minutes to char the edges.
Squeeze over the lime and serve in warm tortillas with salsa.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.summary: Eggs on crispy tortillas with a quick tomato salsa — any meal of the day.
steps: Simmer the tomatoes, jalapeño, onion and cumin for 8 minutes for a quick ranchero sauce.
Warm the beans.
Fry the tortillas in a little oil until crisp at the edges; fry the eggs in the same pan.
Layer tortillas, beans, eggs and sauce. Top with feta and sliced avocado.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice & Beans
recipes.summary: Fluffy tomato rice with pinto beans — a complete meal for pennies.
steps: Toast the rice in the oil over medium heat until lightly golden, 4 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, broth, cumin and salt. Cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Fold in the warmed beans, lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Carnitas
recipes.summary: Citrusy, tender pork with crispy edges — taco night for days.
steps: Rub the pork with cumin, oregano and salt. Put it in the slow cooker with the onion, garlic and the juice of the orange and lime.
Cook on LOW 8 hours until tender, then shred.
Spread on a sheet pan with some cooking juices and broil 5 minutes until the edges crisp.
Serve in warm tortillas with cilantro and salsa.

recipes.title: Veggie Enchilada Casserole
recipes.summary: Layered like lasagna with beans, corn and lots of cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix the beans, corn, pepper and cumin.
Layer in a baking dish: sauce, 4 tortillas, a third of the beans, cheese. Repeat twice, finishing with sauce and cheese.
Cover and bake 25 minutes, then uncover for 10 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Tinga Tostadas
recipes.summary: Shredded chicken in smoky chipotle-tomato sauce on crisp tostadas.
steps: Poach the chicken in salted water 18 minutes, then shred.
Cook the onion in the oil 6 minutes; add the garlic.
Blend or mash the tomatoes with the chipotle and oregano, add to the pan and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in the chicken and salt.
Bake or fry the tortillas until crisp. Top with tinga, cabbage and avocado.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Marinara
recipes.summary: A from-scratch tomato sauce that tastes like it simmered all day — in 25 minutes.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta.
Warm the oil and garlic in a saucepan over medium-low heat until the garlic is fragrant and just golden.
Add the tomatoes, oregano, pepper flakes, salt and sugar. Simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, saving ½ cup of the pasta water.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water. Finish with basil.

recipes.title: Pasta e Fagioli
recipes.summary: Italian bean-and-pasta soup — thick, hearty, and practically free.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and Italian seasoning. Simmer 15 minutes.
Mash a cup of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken.
Add the pasta and simmer 9–10 minutes until tender. Season and serve with parmesan.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
recipes.summary: Saucy, cheesy and made for feeding a crowd or a freezer.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook the ziti 2 minutes short of al dente and drain.
Mix the pasta with the marinara, ricotta, half the mozzarella, the parmesan, Italian seasoning and salt.
Spread in a baking dish, top with the remaining mozzarella.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chicken Parmesan
recipes.summary: Oven-crisp cutlets under bubbling marinara and mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Slice the chicken breasts horizontally into thin cutlets.
Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan and Italian seasoning. Dip the cutlets in beaten egg, then the crumbs.
Place on an oiled sheet pan, drizzle with oil and bake 15 minutes, flipping once.
Spoon marinara over each, top with mozzarella and bake 8 minutes more.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti and toss with the remaining marinara.

recipes.title: Garden Minestrone
recipes.summary: A pot full of vegetables, beans and pasta — eat the rainbow on a budget.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil 6 minutes. Add the zucchini and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and seasoning. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook 9 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.summary: Garlic, oil, chili and pasta. The famous 'midnight pasta' of Italy.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water, saving 1 cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, warm the oil with the garlic over low heat until pale golden. Add the pepper flakes.
Toss the pasta with the garlic oil and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Penne
recipes.summary: Silky pink sauce from pantry staples. Kids love it.
steps: Cook the penne in salted water.
Melt the butter and cook the onion 5 minutes. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and salt; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the cream and parmesan.
Toss with the pasta and basil.

recipes.title: Lentil Bolognese
recipes.summary: All the depth of a meat sauce, for a fraction of the price.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil 8 minutes until soft and sweet. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth, seasoning and salt. Simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are tender, adding water if needed.
Cook the spaghetti and serve the sauce on top.

recipes.title: Homemade Sheet-Pan Pizza
recipes.summary: Pizza night for four at the cost of one delivery pie.
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F (245°C). Oil a sheet pan and stretch the dough to fill it.
Spread the sauce, scatter the cheese, peppers and mushrooms, sprinkle with oregano.
Bake 15–18 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese bubbles.

recipes.title: Lighter Chicken & Broccoli Alfredo
recipes.summary: Creamy without a gallon of cream — milk and parmesan do the work.
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Season and sear the chicken in the oil until cooked, 6–7 minutes. Set aside.
Melt the butter, add the garlic for 30 seconds, whisk in the flour, then the milk. Simmer until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the parmesan, salt and pepper. Toss everything together.

recipes.title: Tuscan White Bean & Kale Soup
recipes.summary: Silky beans, sausage and greens — a hug in a bowl.
steps: Brown the sausage in a pot, breaking it up. Add the onion and cook 5 minutes, then the garlic.
Add the beans, broth, tomatoes and seasonings. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and simmer 5 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: One-Pot Lasagna Soup
recipes.summary: Everything you love about lasagna, without the layering.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, drain, add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth and seasoning; bring to a boil.
Add the broken noodles and simmer 12 minutes until tender.
Serve topped with mozzarella and parmesan.

recipes.title: Better-Than-Takeout Egg Fried Rice
recipes.summary: The best way to use leftover rice — ready in 15 minutes.
ingredients: 1 ⅓ cups long grain rice, cooked and chilled (about 4 cups cooked)
steps: Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil in a hot wok or large skillet; set aside.
Add the remaining oil, the garlic and frozen vegetables; cook 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and press it into the pan. Let it sizzle, then toss. Repeat for 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, eggs and green onions. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Bowls
recipes.summary: Glossy homemade teriyaki over rice with broccoli.
steps: Cook the rice. Steam the broccoli.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, garlic, ginger, cornstarch and ¼ cup water.
Brown the chicken in the oil 6–7 minutes. Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over rice with broccoli and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Beef & Broccoli
recipes.summary: Tender beef in a savory-sweet sauce — faster than delivery.
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the beef with the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the broccoli in 1 tbsp oil with 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes; set aside.
Sear the beef in the remaining oil in batches until browned.
Add the garlic, ginger, soy, sugar and broth; simmer 2 minutes. Return the broccoli and toss.

recipes.title: Veggie Lo Mein
recipes.summary: Slurpy noodles loaded with vegetables in a quick sauce.
steps: Cook the spaghetti; drain and toss with a little sesame oil.
Stir-fry the pepper, carrots and cabbage in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and green onions for 1 minute.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, sugar and remaining sesame oil. Toss over high heat for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Noodles
recipes.summary: Creamy, tangy peanut sauce from the pantry. Eat hot or cold.
steps: Cook the spaghetti; save ½ cup of the water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, vinegar, honey, sriracha, sesame oil and garlic, loosening with pasta water.
Toss the noodles in the sauce. Top with cucumber, carrots and green onions.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken
recipes.summary: Pad kra pao: fiery, fragrant ground chicken with a fried egg on rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the garlic and chilies in the oil for 30 seconds, add the onion and meat and cook 6 minutes over high heat.
Add the soy sauce and sugar, toss, then the basil until wilted.
Fry the eggs crisp at the edges and serve on top of the rice and chicken.

recipes.title: Coconut Chicken Curry
recipes.summary: Mild, creamy and warming — weeknight easy.
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the chicken in the oil; add the onion, garlic and ginger for 4 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder for 1 minute, then the coconut milk, tomatoes and salt. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and finish with lime juice.

recipes.title: 15-Minute Upgraded Ramen
recipes.summary: Instant noodles become a real meal with egg, greens and a garlicky broth.
steps: Soft-boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool and peel.
Simmer the broth with garlic, ginger and soy sauce for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles (save the flavor packets for another day) and cook 3 minutes. Stir in the spinach.
Serve topped with halved eggs, green onions, sesame oil and sriracha.

recipes.title: Pork Fried Rice
recipes.summary: A takeout favourite stretched with eggs and vegetables.
ingredients: 1 ⅓ cups long grain rice, cooked and chilled (about 4 cups cooked)
steps: Stir-fry the pork in 1 tbsp oil until browned and cooked; set aside.
Scramble the eggs; set aside.
Cook the onion and vegetables in the remaining oil 3 minutes, then add the rice and fry 4 minutes.
Return the pork and eggs, add the sauces and green onions, toss well.

recipes.title: Crispy Sesame Tofu
recipes.summary: Golden tofu in a sticky garlic-sesame glaze. Even skeptics come back for more.
steps: Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Press the tofu dry, cut into cubes and toss in cornstarch.
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat until crisp on all sides, 10 minutes.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the soy, syrup and vinegar; toss until glossy.
Serve over rice with broccoli, sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.title: Ginger Chicken Lettuce Wraps
recipes.summary: Light, crunchy and fast — fun to build at the table.
steps: Brown the meat in the oil. Add the mushrooms and cook until their liquid evaporates.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy, honey and sesame oil.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with carrots and green onions.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.summary: Spiced chickpeas in a rich tomato-onion gravy. Weeknight-easy, deeply flavorful.
steps: Cook the rice.
Cook the onion in the oil 8 minutes until golden. Add the garlic, ginger and jalapeño for 1 minute.
Add the spices for 30 seconds, then the tomatoes; cook 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, water and salt. Simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Dal
recipes.summary: Golden, creamy lentils with a sizzling spiced oil on top.
steps: Simmer the lentils with the water, turmeric and salt for 20 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Cook the rice.
In a skillet, cook the onion in the oil until golden. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin and garam masala for 1 minute, then the tomatoes for 4 minutes.
Stir into the lentils and finish with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Weeknight Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.summary: Restaurant flavour from a skillet — no marinating overnight.
steps: Toss the chicken with the yogurt, half the garam masala and the salt.
Cook the rice.
Brown the chicken in 1 tbsp butter in batches; set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter, cook the onion 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer 8 minutes. Stir in the cream and chicken; simmer 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi
recipes.summary: Turmeric-gold potatoes and cauliflower, spiced and roasted.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the cauliflower, potatoes and onion with the oil, spices, ginger and salt.
Roast 30–35 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Finish with cilantro and lemon. Serve with rice or warm flatbread.

recipes.title: Easy Butter Chicken
recipes.summary: Mild and creamy — the gateway curry for the whole family.
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the chicken in 1 tbsp butter; set aside.
Melt the remaining butter; cook the onion 6 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer 8 minutes; blend smooth if you like.
Stir in the cream, salt and chicken. Simmer 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
recipes.summary: North Indian comfort food: kidney beans in a spiced tomato gravy with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Cook the onion in the oil until golden, add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until jammy.
Add the beans, water and salt; simmer 15 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.

recipes.title: Egg Curry
recipes.summary: Hard-boiled eggs simmered in a fragrant onion-tomato masala.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel.
Cook the rice.
Cook the onion in the oil until golden; add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt; simmer 8 minutes. Off the heat stir in the yogurt, then warm gently.
Score the eggs, add to the sauce and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Keema Matar
recipes.summary: Spiced ground beef with peas — a fast, homestyle favourite.
steps: Cook the rice.
Cook the onion in the oil 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and beef and brown well.
Add the spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and salt. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Mujaddara
recipes.summary: Lentils and rice crowned with sweet, crispy onions — one of the world's great frugal dishes.
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 15 minutes until just tender; drain.
Fry the onions in the oil over medium-high heat, stirring, for 20–25 minutes until deep golden and crisp. Lift out half for the top.
Add the rice, cumin and cinnamon to the pot with the remaining onions and stir for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, 3 ½ cups water and the salt. Cover and simmer 18 minutes, then rest 10 minutes.
Serve topped with the crispy onions, with yogurt and cucumber on the side.

recipes.title: Shorbat Adas (Lebanese Lentil Soup)
recipes.summary: Silky red lentil soup with cumin and a big squeeze of lemon. Ramadan's favourite starter.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and potato in the oil 6 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and broth. Simmer 20 minutes until everything is soft.
Blend until smooth, thinning with water if needed. Season with salt.
Toast the pita into crisp squares. Serve the soup with lemon wedges and pita croutons.

recipes.title: Foul Medames
recipes.summary: Warm fava beans with garlic, lemon and lots of olive oil — breakfast of champions across the Arab world.
steps: Warm the beans with their liquid for 5 minutes, then mash about half.
Stir in the garlic, lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Spoon into bowls, flood with olive oil and top with tomatoes, parsley and chili.
Scoop up with warm pita.

recipes.title: Fattoush
recipes.summary: The crunchy Lebanese salad with toasted pita and a tangy sumac dressing.
steps: Tear the pita into pieces, toss with 1 tbsp oil and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 8 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the lemon juice, remaining oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, garlic and salt.
Toss the vegetables and herbs with the dressing. Fold in the pita chips just before serving and sprinkle with more sumac.

recipes.title: Kafta bil Sanieh
recipes.summary: Baked spiced beef kafta with potatoes in tomato sauce — Lebanese home cooking at its best.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix the beef, onion, parsley, seven spice and 1 tsp salt. Shape into small patties.
Toss the potatoes with the oil and remaining salt; roast 15 minutes.
Layer the kafta and tomato slices over the potatoes in a baking dish.
Whisk the tomato paste into the water and pour over. Bake 30 minutes until the kafta is cooked and the sauce is rich.

recipes.title: Musakhan Chicken
recipes.summary: Palestine's beloved sumac chicken with jammy onions on flatbread.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Rub the chicken with 1 tbsp sumac, the allspice, cinnamon, ½ tsp salt and a little oil. Roast 40 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the onions slowly in the rest of the oil with the remaining salt for 25 minutes until soft and sweet. Stir in the remaining sumac.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan.
Spread the onions over the pita, top with the chicken and bake 5 minutes. Scatter with almonds.

recipes.title: Koshari
recipes.summary: Egypt's national dish: lentils, rice and pasta with spicy tomato sauce and crispy onions.
steps: Boil the lentils 20 minutes until tender; drain. Cook the pasta separately and drain.
Fry the onions in the oil until crisp and golden; lift out. Use 1 tbsp of the oil to toast the rice, then cook it with 2 cups water and 1 tsp salt, 18 minutes.
In another tbsp of the oil, cook the garlic, add the tomatoes, vinegar, cumin, pepper flakes and remaining salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Layer rice, lentils and pasta; top with tomato sauce, chickpeas and crispy onions.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.summary: Eggs poached in a spiced pepper-tomato sauce. Bring bread.
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil 8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make 6 wells and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook 6–8 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with feta and parsley and serve with warm bread.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Shawarma
recipes.summary: All the street-food flavour, from your oven, with garlicky yogurt sauce.
steps: Mix ¼ cup yogurt, half the lemon juice, half the garlic, the spices, salt and oil. Toss the chicken in it (marinate up to a day if you can).
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Spread the chicken and onion on a sheet pan and roast 25 minutes, then broil 3 minutes to char.
Stir the remaining yogurt, garlic and lemon juice into a sauce.
Slice the chicken and wrap in pita with tomato, cucumber, pickles and garlic sauce.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel with Tahini Sauce
recipes.summary: Herby, crisp-edged falafel from canned chickpeas — no deep fryer.
ingredients: 2 (15 oz) cans chickpeas, drained and dried
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices and salt in a food processor until finely chopped but not pasty. Mix in the flour and baking powder.
Shape into small patties, brush with oil and bake 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, a pinch of salt and enough cold water to make it creamy.
Stuff into pita with tomatoes, cucumber and tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Riz a Djej (Lebanese Chicken & Rice)
recipes.summary: Spiced rice with a little beef, topped with chicken and toasted almonds — a celebration dish on a budget.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the onion, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, salt and 6 cups water for 25 minutes. Shred the chicken; keep 4 cups broth.
Melt the butter and brown the beef with the seven spice and ground cinnamon.
Add the rice, stir 1 minute, then add the 4 cups of broth. Cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Toast the almonds. Serve the rice topped with chicken and almonds.

recipes.title: Loubieh bi Lahme (Green Bean & Beef Stew)
recipes.summary: Tender green beans in a tomato-beef stew with vermicelli rice.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil. Add the onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, tomatoes, seven spice, 1 tsp salt and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Add the green beans and simmer 15 minutes more.
For the rice: brown the vermicelli in butter, add the rice, 2 ¼ cups water and remaining salt; cover and cook 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Bazella w Riz (Pea & Carrot Stew)
recipes.summary: A cozy Lebanese stew of peas, carrots and a little beef over rice.
ingredients: 2 (12 oz) bags frozen peas and carrots
steps: Brown the beef in the oil with the onion. Add the garlic and allspice.
Add the tomato paste, tomato sauce, water and salt. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add the peas and carrots and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in the cilantro.
Cook the rice with the butter, 2 ¼ cups water and a pinch of salt. Serve the stew over rice.

recipes.title: Batata Harra with Fried Eggs
recipes.summary: Lebanese spicy potatoes with garlic and cilantro — add eggs and it's dinner.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the potatoes with half the oil and salt; roast 30 minutes until crisp.
Warm the remaining oil with the garlic, pepper flakes and paprika for 1 minute; add the cilantro.
Toss the potatoes with the garlic-cilantro oil and lemon juice.
Fry the eggs and serve on top.

recipes.title: Hummus bil Lahme
recipes.summary: Ultra-smooth homemade hummus topped with spiced beef and toasted almonds.
steps: Simmer the drained chickpeas in water for 10 minutes (this makes it silky), then drain.
Blend the warm chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt and ice water until very smooth.
Brown the beef in 1 tbsp oil with the seven spice. Toast the almonds.
Swirl the hummus onto plates, top with beef, almonds, parsley and olive oil. Serve with warm pita.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh
recipes.summary: A parsley salad, not a grain salad: lots of herbs, a little bulgur, plenty of lemon.
steps: Rinse the bulgur and soak it in the juice of 1 lemon for 15 minutes.
Combine the parsley, mint, tomatoes and green onions.
Add the bulgur, remaining lemon juice, oil, salt and allspice. Toss and serve fresh.

recipes.title: Manakish Za'atar
recipes.summary: Lebanese flatbreads with olive-oil za'atar — the breakfast of every Beirut bakery.
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F (245°C) with a sheet pan inside.
Divide the dough into 4 and stretch into thin rounds.
Mix the za'atar and oil into a paste and spread over the dough, leaving a small border.
Bake on the hot pan 6–8 minutes until golden at the edges.
Serve with tomato, cucumber, mint and yogurt (or labneh).

recipes.title: Cauliflower & Chicken Maqluba
recipes.summary: 'Upside-down' spiced rice with roasted cauliflower and chicken, flipped at the table.
steps: Roast the cauliflower and potato with 2 tbsp oil at 425°F (220°C) for 25 minutes until golden.
Brown the chicken in the remaining oil with half the spices and salt; cut into pieces.
Rinse the rice and toss with the remaining spices and salt.
In a heavy pot layer the potato, chicken, cauliflower, then the rice. Pour over the broth, cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes, then flip onto a platter. Top with toasted almonds and serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Shish Tawook
recipes.summary: Lemon-garlic yogurt chicken, oven-charred, with toum-style garlic sauce.
steps: Mix the yogurt, juice of 1 lemon, half the garlic, tomato paste, paprika, oregano, salt and oil. Marinate the chicken 20 minutes or overnight.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Spread the chicken, peppers and onion on a sheet pan and roast 18 minutes, then broil 3 minutes.
Stir the remaining garlic into a little yogurt with the juice of the second lemon for a quick garlic sauce.
Serve with pita and garlic sauce.

recipes.title: Adas bi Hamod (Lemony Lentils & Greens)
recipes.summary: A bright, garlicky lentil and spinach soup-stew from the Lebanese mountains.
steps: Simmer the lentils in the water for 15 minutes. Add the potatoes and cook 10 minutes more.
Add the spinach and simmer 5 minutes.
Sizzle the garlic and cilantro in the oil for 1 minute and stir into the pot with the cumin and salt.
Finish with plenty of lemon juice.

recipes.title: Chicken Kabsa
recipes.summary: The Gulf's favourite one-pot: fragrant spiced rice with chicken, raisins and almonds.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil; set aside. Cook the onion 6 minutes, add the garlic, tomato, tomato paste and spices.
Return the chicken, add 4 cups water and the salt. Simmer 25 minutes. Lift out the chicken and keep warm (or crisp it under the broiler).
Add the rinsed rice and carrot to the broth (top up to 3 cups liquid). Cover and cook 20 minutes.
Toast the almonds and plump the raisins in the same pan. Pile the rice on a platter with chicken, raisins and almonds.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
recipes.summary: Lemony, oregano-scented chicken with potatoes that soak up every drop.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Toss the potatoes and chicken in it.
Arrange in a roasting pan, chicken on top, and pour in the broth.
Roast 45 minutes, basting once, until the chicken is golden and the potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Fakes (Greek Lentil Soup)
recipes.summary: Earthy lentils with tomato, bay and a splash of vinegar.
steps: Cook the onion and carrots in the oil 6 minutes. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, water, bay leaves, oregano and salt. Simmer 35 minutes.
Stir in the vinegar and a final drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Lemony Chickpea Orzo
recipes.summary: Creamy, risotto-like orzo with chickpeas, spinach and parmesan.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil 5 minutes, add the garlic and orzo and toast 2 minutes.
Add the broth gradually, stirring often, about 12 minutes until creamy and tender.
Stir in the chickpeas, spinach, lemon zest and juice, parmesan and salt.

recipes.title: Tuna & White Bean Salad
recipes.summary: A protein-packed pantry lunch with lemon and herbs.
steps: Whisk the lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper.
Toss with the tuna, beans, onion, tomatoes and parsley.
Eat as is or stuffed into pita.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chickpea & Sweet Potato Stew
recipes.summary: Warm spices, sweet potato and chickpeas over fluffy couscous.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potatoes, chickpeas, tomatoes, broth, salt and raisins. Simmer 25 minutes.
Pour 1 ½ cups boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Serve the stew over couscous with cilantro.

recipes.title: Baked Feta Pasta
recipes.summary: The viral one: roasted cherry tomatoes and feta become a creamy sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put the tomatoes in a baking dish, nestle the feta in the middle, add the garlic, oil, pepper flakes and salt.
Bake 30 minutes until the tomatoes burst.
Cook the pasta. Mash the feta and tomatoes into a sauce, toss with the pasta and basil.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki Bowls
recipes.summary: Garlic-oregano chicken with rice, Greek salad and tzatziki.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the oil, half the lemon juice, two-thirds of the garlic, oregano and salt for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Grate half the cucumber into the yogurt with the remaining garlic and lemon juice for tzatziki. Dice the rest.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet 8–10 minutes until charred and cooked.
Build bowls: rice, chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, feta and tzatziki.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Couscous Bowls
recipes.summary: A 15-minute no-cook-ish lunch full of crunch and tang.
steps: Pour 1 ½ cups boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, then fluff.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, oregano and salt.
Toss everything together. Keeps well for lunches.

recipes.title: Espinacas con Garbanzos
recipes.summary: Seville's smoky spinach and chickpeas, mopped up with toast.
steps: Fry the bread and garlic in the oil until golden. Blend or mash with the paprika, cumin and vinegar into a paste.
Simmer the chickpeas and spinach in the broth for 5 minutes.
Stir in the paste and salt; simmer 5 minutes until thick. Serve with toast.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Five minutes tonight, breakfast ready tomorrow.
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, peanut butter, honey and cinnamon.
Divide into 4 jars and refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced banana in the morning.

recipes.title: Veggie Egg Muffins
recipes.summary: Grab-and-go protein for busy mornings.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt. Divide the vegetables and cheese among the cups and pour over the eggs.
Bake 20 minutes until set. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.summary: Blender pancakes with no flour — naturally sweet.
steps: Blend the bananas, eggs, oats, milk, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth. Rest 5 minutes.
Cook ¼-cup pancakes in a buttered skillet over medium heat, 2 minutes per side.
Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
recipes.summary: Make 8 on Sunday, microwave all week.
steps: Brown the sausage; set aside. Cook 3 cups of hash browns until crisp.
Scramble the eggs softly.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, sausage, potatoes, cheese and salsa. Roll tightly.
Wrap in foil and freeze. Reheat 2 minutes in the microwave (unwrapped, in a paper towel).

recipes.title: Smashed Chickpea Salad Sandwiches
recipes.summary: Like tuna salad, but chickpeas. Creamy, crunchy, cheap.
steps: Mash the chickpeas roughly with a fork.
Mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, celery, green onions and salt.
Pile onto bread with lettuce.

recipes.title: Loaded Veggie Omelette
recipes.summary: A fluffy omelette that cleans out the vegetable drawer.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and salt.
Sauté the pepper and mushrooms in the butter 4 minutes; add the spinach to wilt.
Pour in a quarter of the eggs at a time for individual omelettes; cook until nearly set, add cheese and vegetables and fold.

recipes.title: Honey Berry Yogurt Parfaits
recipes.summary: Layers of yogurt, berries and toasted oats.
steps: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and add the oats and cinnamon.
Toast, stirring, for 4–5 minutes until golden and nutty; stir in 1 tbsp honey and spread on a plate to cool and crisp.
Layer the yogurt, berries and oats in glasses and drizzle with the remaining honey.

recipes.title: Fluffy Buttermilk-Style Pancakes
recipes.summary: Breakfast-for-dinner night, with a lemon trick for 'buttermilk'.
steps: Stir the lemon juice into the milk and let stand 5 minutes.
Whisk the dry ingredients. Add the milk, eggs and melted butter and stir until just combined (lumps are fine).
Cook ⅓-cup pancakes on a hot buttered griddle until bubbles form, then flip.
Serve with syrup and berries.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
recipes.summary: Crisp romaine, juicy chicken and a quick Caesar dressing in a wrap.
steps: Season the chicken with garlic powder and salt; cook in the oil 6 minutes per side. Slice.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, Worcestershire and half the parmesan.
Toss the romaine with the dressing and remaining parmesan.
Fill the tortillas with salad and chicken and roll up.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup & Grilled Cheese
recipes.summary: The ultimate cozy pairing, both made from scratch for less than a can of fancy soup.
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion 6 minutes; add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, broth, sugar and salt; simmer 15 minutes. Blend smooth and stir in the cream.
Make sandwiches with the bread and cheese, butter the outsides and cook in a skillet 3 minutes per side until golden.

ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breast, cut into strips
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain, saving a cup of the water.
Season the chicken with salt and brown it in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes; set aside.
Lower the heat, add the garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, seasoning and pepper flakes and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and cream, simmer 3 minutes, then stir in the parmesan and spinach until wilted.
Return the chicken, toss with the pasta and loosen with pasta water as needed.
recipes.summary: The creamy sun-dried tomato chicken everyone's making, stretched with pasta to feed four for less.
recipes.title: Marry Me Chicken Pasta
